name: Glaxosmithkline Pharmaceuticals Ltd
about: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals research, manufacture and make available a broad range of medicines and vaccines that benefit people.(Source : Company Web-site)
keyPoints: Leading Global Health care company[1] GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceutical is a part of GlaxoSmithKline plc (GSK), a British multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in London. GSK underwent a merger in 2000 of Glaxo Wellcome and SmithKline Beecham, and is the world’s sixth-largest pharmaceutical company.
